verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a C++ core with thin platform bindings, token streaming, and NPU/GPU acceleration. None of it documents cold-start latency, runtime binary size, or how quickly inference begins after launch, so the applicable axis is unevidenced. Streaming time-to-first-token and 'thin bindings' are adjacent claims, not cold-start evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
